articles.title: Coal Controller Organisation Recognized for Mine Land Repurposing Tool
articles.description: The Coal Controller Organisation has received a national award for its SUVIKALP tool, designed to assist in the sustainable repurposing of post-mining land.

articles.title: ‘De-foamers installed before tender process’: AAP alleges graft in DJB ahead of Chhath Puja
articles.description: AAP alleges pre-tender corruption in DJB over Yamuna defoaming chemicals ahead of Chhath Puja.
